verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Neon has an official, first-party documentation page titled "Neon serverless driver" under its serverless docs. That is a glancing but direct signal that an official driver aimed at serverless use exists. Nothing in the pack describes how it works. Missing for 10: evidence of HTTP query support, evidence of WebSocket support, explicit edge-runtime compatibility, design for short-lived connections, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query over HTTP or WebSockets from serverless and edge functions with an official driver built for short-lived connections
